-Dorothy Dalton the famous picture star essayed the perils of the upper air Wednesday afternoon in, a flight from Keyport,N.J., to Albany,N.Y. for the Victory Loan.Miss Dalton left the plant of the Aero Marine Plane and motor Company at Keyport at three o'clock and landed safely at the pier of the Albany Dayline two hours later. The popular star was immediately extorted to the State Capitol where she delivered to Governor Smith a letter from Governor Sharing of the Federal Reserve District which she had received from Hinsdale Mess, general manager of the Aero Marine Co., just before she set out on her air journey. C.J.Zimmerman was the pilot and Richard Gretzing the mechanism.
THE CONQUERER OF THREE ELEMENTS.

Amphibian sea-planes are taking part in the Air Ministry's civilian competition for machines capable of alighting upon and rising from both land and water. The Tests which are being carried out at Martlesham and at Felixstowe are very severe, but some of the machines have been remarkably successful in fulfilling them. The Sppermarine is one of the most notable.
Photo shows: How the Supermarine's wheels are drawn up when she comes to rest on the water.

BOTH WITH LOOPS THE LOOP

In all-British toy, which will delight every girl and boy, has been invented by Mr.Hurris, a skilled non-bendic in the employ of the Air Force Aeroplane Company, who worked it out in his spare time. It's no machinery, but can nevertheless loop the loop, now dive and do other aerial stumps. The firm have had several offers for the patents, but they are making a proviso that only disabled men are employed.
Photo shows--Looping the loop

PHILADELPHIR-GONE KITE CRAZY-PRODUCES ANOTHER BIGGEST KITE IN THE WORLD. The big kite pictured here is owned by the Reinhardt Kite Flying Association, of Philadelphia. It is thirty feet high and thirty feet wide, weighs sixty five pounds and measures 452 square feet. Lancerns are hung on it at night. It is collapsible and when not in use can be carried in a suit case.
STUNTING KITE WHICH LOOPS THE LOOP

An all-British toy, which will delight every girl and boy, has been invented by Mr. Morris, skilled mechanic in the employ of the Avro Aeroplane Company, who worked it out in his spare time it has no machinery, but can nevertheless loop the loop, nose dive and do other aerial stunts. The firm have had several offers for the patents, but they are making a proviso that only disabled men are employed, and the price is eighteenpence

ITALIAN AVIATION EXPERIMENTS.

Two Officers of the Italian Air Force have invented an improved type of parachute which they claim will minimise the danger to aviators. Successful experiments have been carried out at Montecolie near ilano. O.P.S. Aviator Freri, making the descent. PP

52211 AVIATION MEET ATMINE OLA, L.I. All types of planes took part in the Aviation meet held at Curtiss Field, Mineola, L.I. yesterday, when the annual air circus was staged to the pleasure of many who journeyd out there to watch their antics. The thrill of the afterno was the leaping from the plane high in the air by Sergeant Johnne Meeks. He is seen hear making the drop. 10/17/21
